description:
GridPulse: Global energy grid intelligence API. NREL + EIA + Open-Meteo data synthesis. Home solar feasibility, electricity rate analysis, time-of-use optimization, EV charging cost modeling, battery storage ROI

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • carbon-intensity ($0.01): Live grid carbon intensity now + forward curve (GB regions + 8 EU countries)
  • compute-window ($0.25): Find the optimal 48h window to run a compute workload (carbon or cost)
  • prices ($0.08): Electricity prices by state
  • grid ($0.08): Power grid status by region
  • renewable ($0.08): Renewable energy profile by state
  • natural-gas ($0.08): Henry Hub natural gas briefing
  • forecast ($0.10): 90-day energy forecast by state
  • ev-cost ($0.08): EV charging cost vs gasoline
  • solar ($0.10): Home solar feasibility analysis
  • appliance ($0.05): Home appliance energy cost calculator
  • battery ($0.10): Home battery storage analysis
  • carbon ($0.05): Household electricity carbon footprint
  • community-solar ($0.08): Community solar enrollment by ZIP code
  • tou ($0.08): Time-of-use rate optimization

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: carbon-intensity | compute-window | prices | grid | renewable | natural-gas | forecast | ev-cost | solar | appliance | battery | carbon | community-solar | tou

age_years.description: Appliance age in years (affects upgrade ROI calculation)

appliance.description: Appliance type (hvac, water-heater, refrigerator, washer, dryer, dishwasher, lighting)

credit_preference.description: Preference for bill credit vs. direct payment programs

goal.description: What to optimise. cost and blend require a region with a published day-ahead price series (DE, FR, BE and other bidding zones).

has_ev.description: true if household has an EV (major TOU savings driver)

has_solar.description: Whether the property already has solar

max_gco2.description: Optional carbon budget in gCO2/kWh. Returns the earliest window meeting it, or satisfiable:false.

monthly_bill.description: Average monthly electricity bill in USD

mw.description: Load in MW — scales the absolute CO2 and EUR savings

region.description: UK | a GB DNO region (london, north-scotland, …) | DE FR NL BE AT ES IT NO

state.description: 2-letter US state code (TX, CA, NY, etc.; default: US)

usage_hours.description: Daily usage hours (default varies by appliance)

utility.description: Utility name (e.g., PGE, SCE, ConEd) for utility-specific TOU plans

name: gridpulse
